.close_menu {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    z-index: 9999991;
}

.close_menu:before, .close_menu:after {
    position: absolute;
    left: 20px;
    content: ' ';
    height: 40px;
    width: 5px;
    background-color: #333;
}

.close_menu:before {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(45deg);
        -ms-transform: rotate(45deg);
            transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.close_menu:after {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(-45deg);
        -ms-transform: rotate(-45deg);
            transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

@media screen and (max-width: 1023px) {

    .fc .cc {
        display: block;
    }
    .fc .rc {

    }

    main {
        padding: 0 10px 0 0;
    }
}

@media screen and (max-width: 736px) {
    #header .prpic {
        background: none !important;
    }
    #header .wr {
        height: 60px;
    }
    #header .logo img {
        width: auto;
        height: 60px;
    }
    #header .main {
        padding :0 5px 0 0;
    }
    #header .main .search .a {
        display: block;
    }
    #header .main li {
        border-left: solid 1px rgba(160, 160, 160, 0.3) !important;
    }
    #header .main ul li.menu {
        display: inline-block;
    }
    #header .main ul li.search .s-inp {
        margin: 10px;
    }
    #header form .s-inp input {
        width: 100%;
    }
    #header .main .search .sf h3{
        display: none;
    }
    #header .main .search .sf {
        overflow: hidden;
        /*display: none;*/
        position: absolute;
        top: 60px;
        left: 0;
        background: #eef1f7;
        width: 100%;
        border-bottom: solid 1px rgba(160, 160, 160, 0.3);
        -webkit-transition: height 0.2s linear;
        -o-transition: height 0.2s linear;
        transition: height 0.2s linear;
        height: 0px;
    }
    #header .main .menu.active {
        background-color: #eef1f7;
    }
    #header .main .search.active {
        background-color: #eef1f7;
    }
    #header .main .search.active .sf {
        display: block;
        -webkit-transition: height 0.2s linear;
        -o-transition: height 0.2s linear;
        transition: height 0.2s linear;
        height: 55px;
    }
    .fc .lc {
        display: none;
    }
    .fc .lc.active {
        display: block;
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        overflow: auto;
        background-color: #fff;
        z-index: 999999;
        padding: 20px 0;
        font-size: 16px;
    }
    .close_menu {
        display: block;
    }
    ul.lc_nav.brands li a {
        font-size: 16px;
    }
    html, body {
        font-size: 16px;
    }
    ul.lc_nav li {
        font-size: 16px;
        padding: 10px 10px;
    }
    .wbl {
        padding: 10px;
    }
    main {
        padding: 0 10px;
    }
}

@media screen and (max-width: 636px) {

        display: block;

    .car-proposal li div.pcnt {
